title: Documentation generation
whenToUse: Document what the code actually does.
whenNotToUse: Inventing features that are not implemented.
promptTemplate:
GOAL:
Document {{component}} for {{audience}}.

CONTEXT:
Only describe existing behavior.

INPUT:
Paths: {{paths}}

CONSTRAINTS:
- No aspirational features
- Mark unknowns

OUTPUT:
README section + examples

ACCEPTANCE:
Another eng can run it.

VERIFICATION:
Commands tested by human.
badPrompt: Write amazing docs for the future vision.
improvedPrompt: Document current auth middleware only; include run/test commands; mark unknowns.
